What product line replaces the ATV61 drives, now that they are obsolete?
Cause: Altivar 61 drives are no longer available
Resolution: The ATV61 has been phased out of production in the US in 2016, and customers need to replace them with a current product.
For more advanced or complicated applications the appropriate replacement for the ATV61 will be the Altivar 600 Product line in most cases.
ATV630... (IP21) replaces the ATV61H... (open style)
ATV650... (IP55) replaces the ATV61W... (Type 12)
